initiatives.name: Ice Cream Business Demerger
initiatives.summary: Following the Ice Cream demerger, Unilever retained a stake in The Magnum Ice Cream Company (TMICC) valued at €1.7 billion, and TMICC made a €2.7 billion payment to Unilever ahead of the demerger as it raised separate debt facilities.

evidence.title: Demerger of Ice Cream Business
evidence.summary: Unilever completed the demerger of its Ice Cream business on 6 December 2025, separating it from the continuing Group. Following the demerger, Ice Cream operations are treated as discontinued operations, and the company now focuses on four continuing Business Groups.
evidence.quote: Following the demerger of our Ice Cream business on 6 December 2025, all territories and activities within the scope of the Ice Cream business have been treated as discontinued operations in the consolidated financial statements.

evidence.title: TMICC Stake Retention and Pre-Demerger Payment
evidence.summary: Following the Ice Cream demerger, Unilever retained a stake in The Magnum Ice Cream Company (TMICC) valued at €1.7 billion, and TMICC made a €2.7 billion payment to Unilever ahead of the demerger as it raised separate debt facilities.
evidence.quote: The decrease in net debt was primarily driven by free cash flow and a €2.7 billion payment by TMICC to Unilever ahead of the demerger, as TMICC raised separate debt facilities... recognition of the retained stake in TMICC of €1.7 billion.

evidence.title: Ice Cream Business Demerger Completed
evidence.summary: Unilever completed the demerger of its Ice Cream business on 6 December 2025, separating it as a standalone entity (The Magnum Ice Cream Company). This followed a strategic portfolio review to create a more focused, category-led business model.
evidence.quote: 2025 marked another year of change for the company, with in particular the implementation of a global productivity programme and completion of the demerger of our Ice Cream business on 6 December 2025.

initiatives.name: Next Wave Organisation Restructuring
initiatives.summary: In 2024, Unilever launched a company-wide productivity programme to improve efficiency and competitiveness, creating a new category-focused business model and organisational structure. The programme is now largely complete with the new structure in place, resulting in restructuring costs and settlements.
initiatives.investmentSummary: €0.4 billion in productivity-related settlements; €599 million restructuring costs in 2025

evidence.title: Next Wave Organisation - Simplification for AI Age
evidence.summary: Unilever is reshaping how it works to be simpler, faster and better connected in the AI Age, shifting from manual, people-centred processes to technology and AI-powered solutions to improve back-end operational efficiency.
evidence.quote: Next Wave Organisation – reshaping how we work to be simpler, faster, better connected in the AI Age... As technology advances and consumer expectations evolve, we are simplifying how we work to accelerate the adoption of AI and enable our Next Wave Organisation, so our people can focus on driving performance.

evidence.title: Company-Wide Productivity Programme Creating Category-Focused Model
evidence.summary: In 2024, Unilever launched a company-wide productivity programme to improve efficiency and competitiveness, creating a new category-focused business model and organisational structure. The programme is now largely complete with the new structure in place, resulting in restructuring costs and settlements.
evidence.quote: Cash flow from operating activities decreased by €0.1 billion, mainly due to €0.4 billion in productivity-related settlements during the year linked to the programme announced in 2024, creating a category-focused business model.

evidence.title: Acquisition of Dr. Squatch, Wild and Minimalist

initiatives.name: Supplier Climate Programme Expansion

evidence.quote: Our scope 3 decarbonisation efforts continue to prioritise supplier engagement, such as our Supplier Climate Programme, which now includes almost 200 suppliers and 40% of raw material scope 3 emissions.

evidence.title: Supplier Climate Programme Expansion
evidence.summary: Unilever expanded its Supplier Climate Programme (SCP) to almost 200 suppliers by end of 2025, accounting for over 40% of scope 3 emissions from raw materials, ingredients and packaging. The company deepened engagement with 25 suppliers to identify GHG hotspots and decarbonisation opportunities.
evidence.quote: By the end of 2025, almost 200 suppliers (2024: 181) were actively participating in the Supplier Climate Programme (SCP), accounting for over 40% of Unilever’s scope 3 emissions from raw materials, ingredients and packaging.

initiatives.name: Senior Leadership Changes Across Unilever
initiatives.summary: Several senior leadership transitions occurred in 2025-2026 including new leaders for Hindustan Unilever, Chief Marketing Officer, and Chief Legal Officer roles, reflecting significant organisational change at the top of the company.

evidence.title: Multiple Senior Leadership Changes Across ULE
evidence.summary: Several senior leadership transitions occurred in 2025-2026 including new leaders for Hindustan Unilever, Chief Marketing Officer, and Chief Legal Officer roles, reflecting significant organisational change at the top of the company.
evidence.quote: With effect from 31 December 2025, Esi Eggleston Bracey stood down from her role as Chief Growth and Marketing Officer and left the Company on 31 January 2026. The role of Chief Marketing Officer, Unilever, and Beauty & Wellbeing is now undertaken by Leandro Barreto. In addition, Maria Varsellona stood down from the role of Chief Legal Officer and Group Secretary and left the Company on 28 February 2026.

initiatives.name: Living Wage and Smallholder Farmer Livelihoods

evidence.title: Living Wage and Smallholder Farmer Livelihoods Programme

initiatives.name: Plastic Reduction and Circular Economy Strategy
initiatives.summary: Unilever's 'reduce, circulate, collaborate' strategy focuses on reducing virgin plastic through post-consumer recycled plastic (PCR), with over 152 kilotonnes of recycled plastic purchased in 2025. The company is also investing in waste collection infrastructure in India, Indonesia and Latin America through Circulate Capital's Ocean Fund, and plans to update targets in 2026 to focus on paper-based flexible packaging.

evidence.title: Plastic Reduction and Circular Economy Strategy
evidence.summary: Unilever's 'reduce, circulate, collaborate' strategy focuses on reducing virgin plastic through post-consumer recycled plastic (PCR), with over 152 kilotonnes of recycled plastic purchased in 2025. The company is also investing in waste collection infrastructure in India, Indonesia and Latin America through Circulate Capital's Ocean Fund, and plans to update targets in 2026 to focus on paper-based flexible packaging.
evidence.quote: In 2025, we purchased more than 152 kilotonnes of recycled plastic in our packaging as part of these and other initiatives. ... through Circulate Capital’s Ocean Fund, we are investing in waste collection infrastructure in places like India, Indonesia and Latin America. ... in 2026 we will update our targets to increase focus on our transition to paper-based flexible packaging.

initiatives.name: Renewable Energy Power Purchase Agreements
initiatives.summary: Unilever implemented multiple renewable energy Power Purchase Agreements (PPAs) in 2025 including a hybrid wind and solar PPA in Poland, a multi-buyer PPA in India, and a virtual PPA in Spain, alongside electrification of thermal energy via heat pumps and electric boilers in the Philippines and India.

evidence.title: Renewable Energy Power Purchase Agreements
evidence.summary: Unilever implemented multiple renewable energy Power Purchase Agreements (PPAs) in 2025 including a hybrid wind and solar PPA in Poland, a multi-buyer PPA in India, and a virtual PPA in Spain, alongside electrification of thermal energy via heat pumps and electric boilers in the Philippines and India.
evidence.quote: In 2025, we implemented a hybrid wind and solar direct Power Purchase Agreement (PPA) in Poland, a multi-buyer PPA with our collaborative manufacturers in India, and a virtual PPA in Spain. We scaled up the electrification of thermal energy by installing industrial-scale heat pumps at sites in the Philippines and India, and we increased our use of electric boilers with an installation at our Cavite site in the Philippines.

evidence.title: Regenerative Agriculture Projects Expansion

evidence.quote: In 2025, we implemented 12 new regenerative agriculture projects, bringing our total to 34 active projects across 17 countries. This includes a new canola programme in Canada and a soy programme in Brazil.

initiatives.name: Fit for AI Age Organisational Transformation
initiatives.summary: Unilever is building a faster, simpler, technology-enabled organisation as part of its strategic framework, deploying AI and technology to power creativity, growth and margin expansion. This includes AI-enabled workflows for supplier onboarding, procurement, and chatbots for HR.

evidence.title: Fit for AI Age - Organisational AI Transformation
evidence.summary: Unilever is building a faster, simpler, technology-enabled organisation as part of its strategic framework, deploying AI and technology to power creativity, growth and margin expansion. This includes AI-enabled workflows for supplier onboarding, procurement, and chatbots for HR.
evidence.quote: In 2025, we shifted from time-intensive, people-centred processes to solutions powered by technology and AI. These changes are helping to make Unilever's back-end operations more efficient. For example, we have deployed chatbots as the first point of contact for most HR matters. AI-enabled workflows are streamlining supplier onboarding in our supply chain, and improving procurement competitiveness through real-time data, faster sourcing decisions and greater efficiency across our global buying operations.

evidence.quote: In Latin America, for example, which had a disappointing year, we have had to take corrective pricing action and adjust our format mix in key categories to get the business back on track.

initiatives.name: AI-Powered R&D and Virtual Simulation

This initiative combines AI, virtual simulation and proprietary data to lead next-generation product innovation.

evidence.title: AI-Powered R&D and Virtual Simulation
evidence.summary: Unilever is leveraging AI and advanced computing to accelerate R&D, compressing decades of lab work into days through virtual mapping, modelling and experimentation before scaling to manufacturing. evidence.quote: Using advanced computing power and AI, we can compress decades of lab work into days, generating insights previously unimaginable. By mapping, modelling and experimenting virtually, we design and simulate every step of the innovation process before scaling for manufacturing.

evidence.title: Unilever Oleochemicals Indonesia Refinery Expansion
evidence.summary: Unilever is expanding its Oleochemicals Indonesia (UOI) refinery as a key part of its growth strategy, while partnering with KIS Group to secure biomethane supplies to maintain scope 1 and 2 climate targets during this growth.
